name: Chopard
summary: The client's 3D models came in mixed formats and sizes. Wrote a Blender + glTF-Transform pipeline to process 60+ watches in batch, down to around 6 MB each. Built the three.js viewer, ready to plug into the CMS, with custom shaders for the diamonds and physics for the moving parts.

name: Devenir
summary: Unreal Engine game played with the mind, using an Emotiv brain-computer interface headset as the controller. Built the game and connected it to the Emotiv API (via Socket.IO) in two months for Digital Festival Zurich, later shown at OMR 23.
award: W3 Best in Show + Webby People's Voice

name: Audemars Piguet
summary: Two sites sharing one style guide: the Musée Atelier website, with a homepage animated in three.js, and the main brand site. Worked with the designers on the 3D parts and adapted them to the constraints of the CMS.

name: Vacheron Constantin
summary: Brand-site front-end architecture, later reused for Baume & Mercier and Audemars Piguet. Earlier, built heavily animated single-page experiences for new watch and collection launches.

name: Hublot
summary: Vue.js app for configuring watch straps, integrated with Hublot's Magento e-commerce. Built it, then maintained it over time.
